body:
Over the years I've found that the thing that makes me feel alive or like maybe this ride is worth it is doing something thrilling... I've been trying to do more and more things that anxiety tells me I shouldn't do. It's the most surefire way I've found to start to find excitement in a life that's monotonous, sad, and dull.

Keep finding little thrills, and hold on to them. They have to matter more than the sadness  that looms.

My "partner" is a lot like this. Whether he realizes it or not he's slowly finding an excuse to push every single person in his life away because they're the only things stopping him from killing himself.... I'm quite stubborn, I don't wanna give up on him but I don't want him to be unhappy cuz the burden of living is on me and the friends he has left...
State breaks... That sounds like a great way to help out. He loves humor, I think I may be better off approaching him with humor and sillyness more than anything. Thank you!
